title: Incomplete Information — Avoids Key Questions
description: Patient is vague and avoids answering safety and history questions

conversation.content: Thank you for reaching out. Could you start by telling me what brings you here today?
I just haven't been feeling well. I don't really know how to explain it.
Take your time. Can you tell me a bit more about what 'not feeling well' means for you?
I don't know. Just... bad. For a while now.
Is there anything specific that's been happening in your life that might be connected?
Not really. Things are just hard.
How has this been affecting your sleep?
It's okay I guess. Not great.
I want to check in with you about your overall wellbeing — have you had any thoughts of harming yourself?
I'd rather not talk about that right now.
That's okay, we don't need to go there now. Do you have people around you for support?
